description:
## Why

An `AssistantMessage` carries multiple content blocks (`:text`, `:thinking`, `:tool_call`) that stream independently. The same three-slot shape from `opi-4dx.8` recurses inside the message: an order list of block ids, data keyed by id, renderers only while a block is streaming, rendered cached iolist per block.

Replaces today's `markdown_streams: %{idx => Stream.t}` map keyed by positional index — that map is the local symptom of "we don't have stable ids yet" and is superseded by the `block_id` plumbing from `.6`.

## Depends on

- `opi-4dx.6` (`MessageBlockStart`/`Delta`/`End` carry `block_id`)
- `opi-4dx.7` (`Markdown.Render` populates `renderers` for `:text` blocks)
- `opi-4dx.8` (`Transcript` shape; AssistantMessage either embeds `%Transcript{}` or mirrors its API)

## Shape

`AssistantMessage` carries an embedded transcript-shaped struct keyed by `block_id`. Either literally embed `%Transcript{}` from `.8` (if the API generalizes cleanly) or hold its own `%AssistantMessage.Blocks{}` mirror — pick whichever is cleaner; the data shape is identical.

Per-kind renderer:
- `:text` → `Markdown.Render` from `.7` (consumes `snapshot` binary on each delta).
- `:thinking` → trivial wrap pass over the text.
- `:tool_call` → existing tool-call rendering (out of scope for incrementality this round).

`update_block(msg, block_id, snapshot)` updates one cell: `Map.update!` on data and `Markdown.Render.put` on the renderer for that id. Other blocks are untouched.

## Code references

- `apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/components/assistant_message.ex` — entire file restructured.
- `apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/components/markdown/stream.ex` — supplanted by `Markdown.Render` from `.7`; the old `markdown_streams` map disappears.
- `apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/components/assistant_message.ex:55-66` — `refresh_streams` re-walk; gone after this lands.

## Acceptance

- `AssistantMessage.render/2` on a message with all blocks finalized emits cached iolist verbatim — no re-walk, no `markdown.render` telemetry span fires.
- `AssistantMessage.update_block/3` on one block doesn't allocate or recompute state for other blocks.
- Mixed `:text` / `:thinking` block ordering preserved across renders.
- The `markdown_streams` field is gone; replaced by the new shape.

## Tests

- Unit: append text block; update twice via `block_id`; finalize; assert renderer dropped from in-flight set; subsequent renders emit zero new lines and reuse cached.
- Mixed-content: thinking at `block_id=0`, text at `block_id=1`, second text at `block_id=2` — assert independent render state per block; updating `block_id=1` doesn't touch the others.
- Out-of-order arrival: `MessageBlockDelta{block_id=2}` arriving after `MessageBlockDelta{block_id=1}` updates only block 2.

## Out of scope

- Interactive wiring (`.10`).
title: AssistantMessage: nest the Transcript shape for content blocks
